integration_issues.issue: FIXED — PlayoffBracket.tsx destructured { activeLeagueId, activeLeague } but useActiveLeague returns { leagueId, league }. critical_code_review_comments: PlayoffBracket.tsx used a destructuring contract that didn't match the hook's exported keys — easy to catch in a TS-strict mode but the file uses // @ts-nocheck which silenced the error. Consider removing @ts-nocheck once types stabilize so similar drift is caught at compile time.

useActiveLeague hook returns leagueId/league, but newer pages assume activeLeagueId/activeLeague. Worth standardizing the public API of this hook (or aliasing both) so future page authors don't repeat this mistake.
Backend modularization is clean — routes/users.py and routes/leagues.py expose cohesive endpoints, server.py reduced ~400 LOC. No regression observed in the 23 focused tests.

Playoff bracket endpoint correctly seeds 1..N, gives byes to top 2 in 6-team bracket, and returns status='projected' when no actual playoff schedule exists. Edge cases for divisions persistence + commissioner gating verified.

rca of the issue: Bug: /playoffs page always rendered empty 'Not enough teams to generate a playoff bracket yet' even though backend returned a valid 6-team bracket with 3 rounds. Reproduction: login as chriszarek, navigate to /playoffs, observe empty state and zero network calls to /api/leagues/{id}/playoff-bracket. Root cause: PlayoffBracket.tsx (line 132) destructured `{ activeLeagueId, activeLeague }` from useActiveLeague(), but the hook returns `{ leagueId, league, ... }`. Both destructured names resolved to undefined; the useEffect's `if (!activeLeagueId) return` short-circuited before any fetch; loading was set false; bracket remained null; component rendered the 'rounds.length === 0' empty branch. The bug went unnoticed because the file uses // @ts-nocheck. Fix: aliased destructuring `const { leagueId: activeLeagueId, league: activeLeague } = useActiveLeague();` — minimum-impact change that preserves all other variable usages. Verified: 2 successful 200 calls to playoff-bracket endpoint, all testids render, 6 seed chips, 2 byes, PROJECTED badge.
